notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays Everyone!

With the holiday season upon us I'd just like to take a moment and wish everyone a happy and safe holiday. If you have been keeping up with my posts (I don't really make a lot) then you will know that the last announcement I made was pretty glum to say the least. After a few months of being away from game dev and working on other projects I am happy to say that I am back and itching to create something again. This time I will make it amazing. I have been toying with ideas here and there, nothing serious yet, but I feel it. The urge I felt when starting FoD and it feels good. I am not sure what is going to happen, and I have not started any new projects yet, but the ideas are starting to come again and this time will be different. Stay tuned.


- Frankie (Frezno)

notes.title: End of First Week
notes.content:
Hey guys, so it's the end of our first week on Steam and I just wanted to say thank you to all of you out there who have purchased the game, whether it be through Steam or in the Groupees bundle. It's awesome to see how many people have actually activated the game and have played it on Steam.

Feed back is great, and if you have and please make a review. I want to do everything in my power to make sure that any problems in the game get fixed as soon as possible.

- Frankie
